Author: brianwbeal
Description:
[b][size=5]Fridge Better[/size][/b]

Expands available storage space in the kitchen fridge and mini-fridges.

Slots are fit to the game window, and paginate with left/right arrows.

Up to 1200 slots.

Customize in `config.json`, or Generic Mod Config Menu.
